crossRefs.note: “But ask the animals, now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.

translations.web: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:
translations.bsb: Four things on earth are small, yet they are exceedingly wise:
translations.kjv: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:
translations.asv: There are four things which are little upon the earth, But they are exceeding wise:
